paite: TOUPA, suan tengteng tan a ka tenna uh nangmah na hi a,
heading: Pathian Leh Mihing Tanchin / BU LINA / (Sam 90-106) / Pathian Mi, Mosi Thumna
english: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

paite: Tangte pian ma a, leitung leh khovel na bawlkhiak ma in leng; tangtawn a kipan tangtawn Pathian, nangmah na hi.
english: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

paite: Nang mihingte manthatna ah na kiksak a; mihing tate aw, kikta un, na chi zel hi.
english: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”

paite: Nang seh in kum sangkhat zan mangta bang phet ahi a, zanven khat sung bang phet ahi.
english: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

paite: Amaute tui lian bang in na taimang a; khang khat ihmu bang phet ahi ua, zingsang a loupa dawnkhia bang ahi uhi.
english: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

paite: Zingsang in ahong pou in ahong dawnkhia a; nitaklam in phuk in a-om a, avuai hi.
english: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

paite: Na hehna a hihman in ka om ua, na thangpaihna a hihmangbat a leng ka om ziak un.
english: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

paite: Ka thulimlouhnate uh na ma ah na koih a, ka khelhna gukte uh na mel vak ah na koihta hi.
english: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

paite: Ka damsung ni tengteng uh na hehna ah amang zel a; ka damsung kumte uh tangthu bang in ka tawpsak uhi.
english: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

paite: Ka damsung kumte uh kum sawmsagih ahi a, hatna ziak in kum sawmgiat leng ahi thei hi; himahleh asawtna zaw sepgimna leh lungngaihna lel ahi a; amang pah a, kou leng ka lengmang zel uhi.
english: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

paite: Kua'n ahia na hehna thilhihtheihdan thei a, nangmah kihtakdan ding a na hehna thei lou?
english: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

paite: Ka damsung nite uh simdan hon hilh in, huchi a pilna lungtang ka neihloh hialna ding un.
english: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

paite: TOUPA aw, hong kik nawn in; bang tan ahia na heh ding? Na sikhate tungthu ah na lungsim kiheisak in.
english: Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

paite: Aw, zingsang in na zahngaihna in hon taisak in; ka damsung tengteng ua ka nuam ua ka kipahtheihna ding un.
english: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

paite: Nang na hon hihgim ni leh, thil hoih lou ka tuah kum sung hute bang un hon kipaksak in.
english: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

paite: Nna nasep na sikhate kiang ah kithei henla, na thupina atate kiang uah kithei hen.
english: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian uh kilawmna ka tung uah om hen, ka khut nasep uh ka tung uah leng hihkip in; ahi, ka khut nasep uh hihkip in.
english: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
